Byte-by-byte Description of file: apjsae472et2_mrt.txt
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Bytes Format Units      Label     Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1- 22 A22    ---        ID        Unique identifier for each source
  24- 31 F8.5   deg        RAdeg     Right Ascension of the source in degrees (J2000)
  33- 40 F8.5   deg        DEdeg     Declination of the source in degrees (J2000)
  42- 47 F6.2   rad/m2     RM        Rotation Measure (1)
  49- 52 F4.2   rad/m2   e_RM        Uncertainty in RM
  54- 58 F5.2   %          fracpol   Fractional Polarization of source
  60- 65 F6.2   mJy/beam   SRefFreq  Total flux density in reference frequency
  67- 72 F6.2   uJy/beam   RMS       Local RMS noise level for the polarized source
  74- 74 I1     ---        F1        Flag indicating the location of the source relative to diffuse Galactic polarized emission (2)
  76- 76 I1     ---        F2        Flag indicating Faraday complexity of the source based on the Faraday dispersion function (3)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Note (1): Rotation measures were derived using RM synthesis and RM CLEAN. 
Note (2): 
    0 = outside diffuse emission,
    1 = inside diffuse emission,
    2 = inside diffuse emission with polarized intensity greater than 
        twice the maximum value within the diffuse mask.
Note (3):
    0 = single peak;
    1 = multiple peaks.
